description: This Dart source file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news application. It sets up a tabbed interface with various news categories, manages navigation to a saved news screen, and displays error messages if present.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides a tabbed interface for navigating different news categories, including an app bar with navigation to saved news, and displays error messages if applicable.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A simple data class that pairs a tab title with its corresponding widget for the tab view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including the app bar, tab bar, and tab views, managing state and error display.
